summary: RFC-0062 OQ-5: resource-aware packing is single-host, first-fit by expected cost within the pacer cap behind one fits(task, headroom) seam; a multi-host successor depends on RFC-0060 OQ-3, OQ-4 and OQ-5

options.description: Single-host packing here; RFC states the RFC-0060 OQ-3/4/5 dependency for the successor
Executor cap is the only resource control

body: Full rubric in RFC-0062 OQ-5 resolution (2026-11-06). Borg and Omega separate ordering from placement; the ranking is host-independent and survives any placer. RFC-0060 has all ten OQs open and no date. The constraint here is a token budget per window, so cost-aware filling matters once calibration exists.
